knobs.name: capture_twice
knobs.mechanism: CAPTURE is sent twice in a row (command productManager.CAPTURE, inserted copy); two products are written where the test expects one

knobs.name: corrupt_product

L2-5: sha256 of record/raw/files/<P2> == hash in the sysTester.Sha256 event
L2-6: ground file starts FFD8 and ends FFD9
L2-9:
sha256 of record/raw/files/

== hash in the sysTester.Sha256 event

knobs.mechanism: sysTester.CORRUPT_PRODUCT(name) is inserted before productManager.DOWNLINK (after any DUMP_SHA256): the first two bytes of the picture record of the stored product are overwritten on board, so the file sent differs from the file hashed and is no JPEG; each test removes its products at teardown, so no later test or the final state sees it

knobs.name: dump_sha_other

L3-1: the two Sha256 events are equal
L5-15: the two Sha256 events are equal

knobs.mechanism: argument `name` of the second sysTester.DUMP_SHA256 of the test is rewritten to the deployment's own executable file, so the second hash differs from the first

knobs.name: sensor_line_kept_on
knobs.mechanism: argument `state` of sysTester.BENCH_LINE is rewritten from OFF to ON: the sensor keeps answering
